name: Nudge
pitch: An action RPG with tower defense: recover crystals, collect loot, craft equipment, and build your skills to help restore a girl’s suppressed memories.
features: Combine direct action RPG combat with strategic tower placement against waves of enemies.
Collect loot and unique items, and craft equipment using Exile-inspired systems.
Unlock skills and experiment with builds in a Skill Grid that grows as you level up.
Play solo with full controller support, including Xbox and PlayStation controllers.
English and Simplified Chinese interfaces and subtitles.
description: Take control of Nudge and fight enemy waves while positioning towers to support your defense. Discover loot and unique items, or craft your own equipment with Exile-inspired mechanics. As you level up, expand a distinctive Skill Grid and combine newly discovered skills into different builds. Recover crystals along the way to help restore a girl’s suppressed memories.

name: Break the Planet
pitch: A satisfying, meditative incremental game about shooting balls and breaking planets.

features.title: Fire balls at procedurally generated planets
features.description: Every planet is different. Shoot balls, break voxels, and slowly tear each world apart.

features.title: Find the white voxel hidden in each planet
features.description: Every planet hides one white voxel. Break your way through the planet and find it to move on.

features.title: Play with 7 different ball types
features.description: Unlock 7 unique ball types, each with its own way of destroying planets. Combine them and find the fastest way to break everything.

features.title: Build your own skill tree
features.description: Spend what you collect on a large, non-linear skill tree. Upgrade your balls, unlock new abilities, and shape each run differently.

features.title: Grow stronger with every run
features.description: Each run makes you stronger. Reset, unlock permanent upgrades, and work your way toward destroying the massive 10-billion-voxel planet.

features.title: Uncover a hidden mystery
features.description: There is more to the planets than destruction. Find hidden objects, strange structures, and clues that can lead you to the true ending.
